source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.7.1 (PDF 221), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Collaboration (mil kar kaam karna) tab hota hai jab do ya zyada log ek common goal (sab ka ek hi maqsad) hasil karne ke liye saath kaam karte hain. Is mein masle hal karne ya kuch naya banane ke liye ideas, resources (paisa, saaman, waqt) aur mehnat baanti jati hai. Pakistan mein collaboration bohat jagah nazar aata hai, maslan jab students group project par mil kar kaam karte hain, ya jab mohalle ke log mil kar koi event (taqreeb) karwate hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Farz karein aap aur aap ke classmates ko exhibition ke liye science model banane ko kaha gaya hai. Har koi alag kaam karne ke bajaye aap mil kar kaam karne ka faisla karte hain. Ek student diagram banane mein achha hai, doosra model banane mein, aur teesra project doosron ko samjhane mein. Mil kar kaam karne se aap sab ki khoobiyan jur jati hain aur aisa project banta hai jo aap mein se koi akela nahi bana sakta tha.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurship ke process (amal) mein collaboration kyun zaroori hai (short question 8)?
blocks.explanation: Kisi ek founder mein har skill nahi hoti. Partners, employees (mulazim) aur advisors (mashwara dene wale) alag alag khoobiyan, ideas aur resources late hain, is liye masle jaldi hal hote hain aur karobar mazboot hota hai.

items: Collaboration: common goal ke liye ideas, resources aur mehnat baantna; sab ki khoobiyan mil kar behtar nateeja.
